title: The Shortest Way Between Two Chords
summary: Voice-leading distance is the smallest total semitone motion between two chords. Build a pair, reassign the voices, and watch the number fall to its minimum.

sources.title: Tymoczko, The Geometry of Musical Chords (Science, 2006)
Cohn, Neo-Riemannian Operations, Parsimonious Trichords (Journal of Music Theory, 1997)
Callender, Quinn and Tymoczko, Generalized Voice-Leading Spaces (Science, 2008)
